Informatica is a tool that supports all steps of Extraction, Transformation, and Load process and also used as an integration tool. A simple user interface and with a drag and drop functionality, Informatica is quite easy to use the tool. This tool can interact with major data sources like XML, VSM, SAP, etc. It can move data in huge volumes in a very effective way. For Example – Doing the bigger updates in smaller transactions to avoid the locking, also known as Data Throttling. All these factors make Informatica one of the best tools available in the current market scenario.
